records: XRP Insights' October 30 daily -207.3M same-wallet change is an all-exchange aggregate, not a Binance-only or per-wallet balance change. Its daily bars exclude exchanges with wallet-set changes; its 7d/30d same-wallet windows use different start/end cohorts. No per-wallet daily history is published. The incident transfer's 88.8% magnitude comparison is not causal attribution. Regional balances use exchange HQ/registration, not customer geography. Cold/unclassified and non-customer reserves prevent tradable-float inference.
